# Pictures fixture

`pictures.docx` is written by `make_fixture.py` from hand-written WordprocessingML, without the
editor's engine, so the Picture Format, Shape Format and Arrange reader paths are checked against a
package this editor did not produce. It holds a picture with luminance, grayscale and alpha effects, a
white outline and a shadow, alt text and a title; a decorative processed picture whose original is
kept in its original layer; a cropped picture with tight wrapping and a wrap polygon; a margin-centred
group of an oval with a gradient fill and a dashed double outline and a rounded box; a square-wrapped
text box with glow, reflection and soft-edge effects and WordArt run effects; and a hidden star.
The PNGs are generated by the script. License: same as this repository.
Regenerate with `python3 make_fixture.py` (Python standard library only).
